v.description: Version of the schema. Increased only on breaking changes.
v.title: V

fw.description: Firmware version (optionally containing the git commit hash)
fw.title: Fw

boot.description: Boot counter, stored on flash memory of the microcontroller.
boot.title: Boot

run.description: ID of the run (measurement series) this record belongs to; null outside a run. Unique per device: a counter stored on flash like boot, incremented and written before the run's start record, so a power loss can skip an ID but never reuse one. (dev, run) identifies a run.
run.title: Run

seq.description: Sequence number per record kind, for dedup (QoS 1, SD replay) and gap detection per kind. For data it counts per run and restarts at 0 with every run; for all other kinds it counts per boot. Unique key: (dev, run, seq) for data, (dev, boot, k, seq) for all other kinds.
seq.title: Seq

up.description: Monotonic seconds since boot, ms resolution. Time of measurement/event, not of sending. Use for intervals: ts may jump on re-sync.
up.title: Up

ts.description: Unix seconds UTC after NTP sync, captured together with up. null while unsynced; key is mandatory.
ts.title: Ts

module.description: Module of the firmware the error originates from.
module.title: Module

code.description: Error code; its meaning depends on the module.
code.title: Code

state.description: State of the module at the time of the error. Only applicable if the module has a state.
state.title: State
